$comment: Plan-derived threshold constants for the WP-6.3 performance scenarios (MT-6.3-01). Sources: parent plan Section 5.2 (NFR-02, NFR-03, NFR-09) and Section 13.4 (board first-load). NEVER edit these values to make a run pass — MT-6.3-03 lists threshold edits as out of scope (plan NFRs are not this task's to change).

nfr02.source: Section 5.2 NFR-02 — claim and checkpoint p95 < 300 ms locally

nfr03.source: Section 5.2 NFR-03 — event delivery p95 < 2 s; push dispatch within 10 s

nfr09.source: Section 5.2 NFR-09 — scale envelope without architectural change

scenario.source: Section 18 Performance row — 20 simulated agents with checkpoints every 30 s; 10,000 tasks; board load; SSE fan-out

board.source: Section 13.4 web first-load target (browser side owned by MT-4.11-04, see docs/plan/web-performance-report.md); api_share_p95_ms is a DERIVED necessary condition for that budget (if the API alone exceeds it the web target cannot hold) — it is not an NFR
